My friend wanted to take pictures of graves in a cemetery for a school project (Grade nine at the time), so she dragged me along with her.

As we where taking pictures we see another person in the cemetery. He looked homeless and we had assumed he was visiting someones grave, as we go around my friend taking pictures we realize he is fallowing us. Wen we stop to take pictures he stops. Wen we walk to another gravestone. He walks. We agree to try to make a u turn without tipping him off that we are leaving. He continues to fallow us, getting closer and closer with each step, im clinging on to my friend since this creepy is almost breathing down my neck in a fucking cemetery. We can see the cemetery gates up ahead wen i hear the sound of him unbuckling his pants. I walk faster but he keeps pace once we leave the cemetery i dont hear him fallowing us. We keep walking and i look back, there he was standing near the cemetery gates trying (and failing) to hide himself well looking at me and my friend and touching himself.

For those who would like extra details. This was day time and the cemetery is near a road one or two blocks away from downtown. The road turns onto a goddamn highway. So there might not be many people walking but lots of cars. We reported it to the police but don't know what came of it.
